verdict.rationale: A probe confirms a live llms.txt at airwallex.com (HTTP 200), and the docs site serves its own llms.txt. Pages are also available as .md files. Airwallex publishes dedicated 'Instructions for AI agents' pages written for machine consumption, plus an unauthenticated Docs MCP for documentation lookups, so an agent has several agent-oriented entry points. Missing for 10: independent or community hands-on corroboration of agents actually using these docs; the root /docs.md path returns 404.
